COIL (subs.):
(1) गुणः (of a rope);
(2) कुण्डलम्
(of a serpent);
(3) व्यावर्तनम् (c. ing round),
by the c. s of the serpent-king:
व्यावर्तनैरहिपतेः, Ki.

COIL (v.):
(1) पिण्डीकरोति (into a globe);
(2)
कुण्डलीकरोति, V. p. com.
C. ed round by the
serpent-king:
सर्पराजेन भोगेनावेष्टितः (ता, तं), V. p.

COIN (subs.):
(1) मुद्रा,
copper -c.:
ताम्रमुद्रा;
(2)
नाणकम् (rare), Mr. To pay any one in his own c.
*सदृशशोधं ददाति।

COIN (v.):
I To stamp: टङ्कयति (nomi.) (?).
II To invent, originate: q. v. सृजति (सृज्,
c. 6.).

COINAGE:
I Coining: टङ्कनम् (?).
II Money
coined: मुद्रा।
III Invention: q. v.: सृष्टिः।

COINCIDE (v.):
I To Agree, correspond,
concur: q. v.
II To agree in position:
एकीभवति।

COINCIDENCE:
I Agreement, correspon-
-dence: q. v.
II Agreement in position
expr. by verb.
III Accident: दैवयोगः।

COINCIDENT, COINCIDENTAL:
I Of time:
समकालीनः (ना, नं).
II Consistent: q. v.
III
Corresponding: q. v.

COINER:
I Lit.: मुद्राकारः (?).
II An inven-
-tor, maker: q. v.
